summary: Practise RFQs, RFPs, works tender checks and supplier evaluation in five days. Explore the procurement training outline and enrol.
lede: Procurement across goods, services and works involves defining needs, comparing supplier offers and managing contract delivery. For procurement officers, category managers and contract administrators, this course supports documented sourcing decisions through spend and total-cost analysis, bid evaluation, and supplier-risk and contract-control records.
audienceIntro: Procurement of goods, services and works training suits professionals who prepare sourcing documents, assess supplier offers or oversee delivery against purchase contracts. This course is designed for: Procurement Officers preparing purchase specifications and documenting supplier selection. Category Managers segmenting goods, services and works spend. Sourcing Specialists issuing RFQs, RFPs and invitations to tender. Supplier Evaluation Analysts maintaining bid criteria and scoring records. Procurement Operations Managers overseeing approval and purchase-order controls. Contract Administrators tracking service milestones, variations and acceptance. Works Procurement Specialists coordinating tender inputs with technical teams. Supplier Risk Analysts reviewing capacity, dependency and delivery exposure. Facilities Managers defining outsourced service requirements and performance measures. Procurement Directors reporting sourcing outcomes and contract risks to leadership.
modules: Procurement Training: Kraljic Matrix and TCO
Procurement Training: RFP and Service Levels
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
